verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework driven by explicit CLI subcommands such as `proa new site`, `proa ui add` and `proa fmt`. The evidence shows no first-party interface that accepts natural-language commands. Its agent-oriented features (a scaffolded AGENTS.md, Markdown docs routes, /llms-full.txt) help an external AI agent understand and edit a project, but the agent supplies the natural-language operation, so this is adjacent support, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
